tree_hash_algorithm: sha256 over sorted relative_path NUL file_sha256 LF records
empty_split_policy: No split may be populated by a runtime sampler.

leakage_policy.rule: A video appears in exactly one split. A held-out source_id appears in no earlier split.

development.notes: The filename suggests EXIT, but current GT keeps car present for all frames; no EXIT event is registered.

selection_decision.legacy_development: All ten ETRI videos remain development-only.
selection_decision.pilot: Deterministic maximum matching selects 10 provider-GT-derived events of each type ENTER, EXIT, OCCLUDE, and REAPPEAR from distinct OVIS validation videos.
selection_decision.train: All official YouTube-VOS 2019 train video IDs.
selection_decision.validation: All 507 official YouTube-VOS 2019 valid video IDs; the former v1.1 Pilot is returned to Validation without time reversal.
selection_decision.heldout_test: All 30 official DAVIS 2017 val IDs; source-disjoint and sealed from method tuning.
